content: ## Metadata_Start ## code: en ## title: Spreedly ## slug: spreedly ## seoTitle: ## description: ## contentType: Markdown ## Metadata_End Spreedly is a service that allows you to securely store credit cards and use them to perform transactions for a number of PaymentGateways and third-party APIs. It does this by simultaneously providing a card tokenization/vault service as well as a gateway and receiver integration service. PaymentMethods tokenized by Spreedly are stored at Spreedly, allowing you to independently store a card and then pass that card to different endpoints based on your business requirements. We refer to the ability to use a {{variable.Product_Spreedly}} token against multiple gateways/end points as “universal tokenization.” To read more about {{variable.Product_Spreedly}}, click [here](https://docs.spreedly.com/){target="_blank"}. ## Spreedly Payment Gateways ### Supported and Fully Tested * Cybersource via Spreedly ### Used by Blackthorn Customers, but Not Fully Tested * Braintree * Cardconnect * Elavon * eWAY * Fat Zebra * Litle * Orbital * Payflow Pro * Paypal * Sage ### Not Supported * Worldline ## Set Up the Payment Gateway Page Layout {{snippet.PGSetup_Spreedly_UpdatePGpgLay}} ### Spreedly and Iframed Components Spreedly has updated its authentication requirements for iframes, resulting in changes to the {{variable.Product_Events}} app’s iframe checkout process. The following changes ensure the {{variable.Product_Events}} webapp correctly passes newly required values to the Spreedly gateway when {{variable.Object_Event}} registrations occur via an iframe. Complete the following steps to enable the new authentication method. #### Update Spreedly Configuration 1. Navigate to Environment Settings in the Spreedly dashboard. 2. Enable the checkbox "Enable Secure Tokenization." 3. Select the option "iFrame or Spreedly Express." #### Blackthorn Configuration Confirm that the following fields are on the {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}} page layout you use for your Spreedly gateway. * {{variable.Field_PG_SpreedlyEnviroKey}} (bt_stripe__Spreedly_Environment_Key__c) This field stores the environment key that is included in your API credentials. Spreedly auto-generates the key and uses it to reference the environment that organizes your payment data. * {{variable.Field_PG_SpreedlyConfigGateway}} (bt_stripe__Spreedly_Configured_Gateway__c) This field stores the Payment Gateway that was created with Spreedly. * {{variable.Field_PG_SpreedlyCertificToken}} (bt_stripe__Spreedly_Certificate_Token__c) This field stores the Spreedly certificate token used for payment gateway routing. Spreedly auto-generates it and uses it to reference the stored certificate securely. Known in Spreedly as certificateToken, it is a public identifier for your key pair and helps Spreedly verify that the signature was generated with your private key. (This can be used in the frontend.) * {{variable.Field_PG_SpreedlyPrivateKey}} (bt_stripe__Spreedly_Private_Key__c) This field stores the PEM-formatted private key used for SSL client certificate authentication with Spreedly. Known as PRIVATE_KEY in Spreedly, the key is used to digitally sign a message so Spreedly can verify the message is coming from your system. (This should be only used on the backend of the {{variable.Product_Events}} webapp and {{variable.Product_PayLink}}.) #### Permission Sets Users with the Blackthorn | Payments (Admin) permission set have Read/Edit access. All other permission sets except Blackthorn | Payments (Stripe Billing), which has no access, have Read access. Additional information about these fields is on the Spreedly dashboard. ### Set Up Braintree** Complete the following steps to set up Braintree. 1. Gather the following details from your Braintree account. * Merchant Account Id * Merchant Id * Public Key * Private Key 2. After logging in to Braintree, go to Settings. * The Merchant Account Id and Merchant Id can be found on the Business Tab, under Merchant Accounts. * The Public Key and Private Key are on the API tab under Keys. 3. On the Spreedly gateway record, click the **Create Spreedly Gateway** button. 4. Select Braintree from the list of gateways. 5. Change the Auth Mode to Blue. 6. Enter the details gathered above into the matching fields. ***Braintree is used by some Blackthorn customers, but Blackthorn does not officially support Braintree. Use at your own risk.* ## Virtual Terminal Custom Setting {{snippet.PAY_CS_VT_ShowAddress_Spreedly}} ## Add A Spreedly Payment Gateway NOTE: When setting up a {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}} using Spreedly, you cannot add Authorize.net and Stripe as a gateway. Authorize.net and Stripe function as stand-alone {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}}s. 1. Contact {{variable.Link_BlackthornSupport}} to obtain a Spreedly Environment Key. 2. Navigate to the {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}} object. 3. Click {{variable.button_new}}. 4. Enter a {{variable.Field_PG_PaymentGatewayName}}. 5. Set {{variable.Field_PaymentGateway_Provider}} = “Spreedly”. 6. Check the {{variable.Field_PTPaymentGateway_TestMod}} checkbox if you are setting this up in your sandbox for testing. Do not check the box if this is a Live Payment Gateway in production. 7. Populate the {{variable.Field_PG_DefaultCurrency}} and {{variable.Field_PG_DefaultCountry}} fields. 8. Enter the key provided by Blackthorn Support in the {{variable.Field_PG_SpreedlyEnviroKey}} field. ![Spreedly New PG](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/Spreedly%20New%20PG.png){height="" width=""} 9. Click {{variable.Button_Save}}. 10. Click the {{variable.Button_CreateSpreedlyGateway}} button. 11. Select the {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}} you want to connect (Ex. CardConnect; EBANX). For test mode, select "Spreedly Test". 12. If prompted, add additional information from the selected gateway. 13. Click **Create**. 14. The {{variable.Field_PG_SpreedlyConfigGateway}} and {{variable.Field_PG_GatewayToken}} fields will be populated automatically. ### Add a CyberSource Payment Gateway {{snippet.Deploy_Spreedly_CybersourcePG}} ## Test Spreedly Test your Payment Gateway using either the test {{variable.Product_Spreedly}} card or the test {{variable.Product_Spreedly}} ACH bank account. ### Test a Spreedly Card {{snippet.PGSetup_TestSpreedly_Card}} {{snippet.Spreedly_ACH_Limitation}} ### Test a Spreedly ACH Bank Account {{snippet.PGSetup_TestSpreedly_ACHAcct}} :::(Warning) (Default Payment Method Limitation) The default logic related to Payment Methods, which is offered as part of our Integrations to Stipe and Authorize.net, is not supported for Spreedly since Spreedly doesn’t have an equivalent record to the Payment Gateway Customer object. Customers can create matching logic with automation to work around this limitation. ::: ## Create Credit Card Payment Methods :::(Warning) (LIMITATION) If you create a new {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} for a Spreedly gateway by clicking the {{variable.button_new}} button on the {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} List view, the new {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} will be saved, but the {{variable.Field_PM_PaymentMethodStatus}} will not be updated to “Valid” or “Invalid.” ::: ### From the Payment Method Object 1. Navigate to the {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} object. 2. Click {{variable.button_new}}. 3. Set {{variable.Field_PM_RecordType}} = "Card" 4. Fill in the following fields. 1. {{variable.Field_PM_HoldersName}} 2. {{variable.Field_PM_AccountHolderType}} 3. {{variable.Field_PM_CurrencyISO}} 4. {{variable.Field_PM_CountryISO}} 5. Set {{variable.Field_PM_PaymentGateway}} = “Spreedly”. 6. Click {{variable.Button_Save}}. ### From the Virtual Terminal 1. Navigate to an object or record where you can access the {{variable.Component_VirtualTerminal}} ({{variable.Object_Opportunity}}, {{variable.Object_Invoice}}, etc..) 2. Set {{variable.Field_VT_Action}} = "New Payment Method". 3. Set {{variable.Field_VT_PaymentGateway}} = “Spreedly”. 4. Click the CREDIT CARD tab. 5. Fill in the following fields. 1. {{variable.Field_VT_NameOnCard}} 2. {{variable.Field_VT_CardNumber}} 3. {{variable.Field_VT_CardExpiration}} 4. {{variable.Field_VT_CVC}} 5. {{variable.Field_VT_PostalCode}} 6. Click **Add +**. ## Create ACH Payment Methods {{snippet.Spreedly_ACH_Limitation}} ### From the Payment Method Object 1. Navigate to the {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} object. 2. Click {{variable.button_new}}. 3. Set {{variable.Field_PM_RecordType}} = "ACH". 4. Fill in the following fields. 1. {{variable.Field_PM_HoldersName}} 2. {{variable.Field_PM_AccountHolderType}} 3. {{variable.Field_PM_CurrencyISO}} 4. {{variable.Field_PM_CountryISO}} 5. Set {{variable.Field_PM_PaymentGateway}} = “Spreedly”. 6. Click {{variable.Button_Save}}. ### From the Virtual Terminal 1. Navigate to an object or record where you can access the {{variable.Component_VirtualTerminal}} ({{variable.Object_Opportunity}}, {{variable.Object_Invoice}}, etc..) 2. Set {{variable.Field_VT_Action}} = "New Payment Method". 3. Set {{variable.Field_VT_PaymentGateway}} = “Spreedly”. 4. Click the BANK tab. 5. Fill in the following fields. 6. {{variable.Field_VT_NameOnAccount}} 7. {{variable.Field_VT_AccountHolderType}} 8. {{variable.Field_VT_RoutingNumber}} 9. {{variable.Field_VT_AccountNumber}} 10. Click **Add +**. ## Process a Payment NOTE: Blackthorn Payments does not support using DocumentLink to make a payment with a Spreedly Payment Gateway. ### From the Transaction Object 1. Navigate to the {{variable.Object_Transaction}} object. 2. Click {{variable.button_new}} to create a new record. 4. Select the "Charge" for the {{variable.Field_Transaction_RecordType}}. 5. Enter the amount in the {{variable.Field_Transaction_Amount}} field. 6. Select your {{variable.Field_Transaction_PaymentGatew}}. 7. Select the {{variable.Field_Transaction_PaymenMethod}}. 8. Click {{variable.Button_Save}}. 9. Click {{variable.Button_Capture}} to charge the Transaction.. ### From Virtual Terminal 1. Navigate to an object or record where you can access the {{variable.Component_VirtualTerminal}} ({{variable.Object_Opportunity}}, {{variable.Object_Invoice}}, etc..) 2. Set {{variable.Field_VT_Action}} = "New Single Charge". 3. Set {{variable.Field_VT_PaymentGateway}} = “Spreedly”. 4. Fill in the following fields. 1. {{variable.Field_VT_RelatedTo}} 2. {{variable.Field_VT_PaymentMethod}} 3. {{variable.Field_VT_Amount}} 4. {{variable.Field_VT_Currency}} 5. {{variable.Field_VT_ProcessType}} 5. Click **Process**. ### FAQ #### How do eChecks work with Spreedly? Customers can create ACH Payment Methods with {{variable.Product_Spreedly}} that can be used with a gateway's eCheck service. See more details about the eCheck gateways that {{variable.Product_Spreedly}} supports [here](https://docs.spreedly.com/guides/echecks/?_ga=2.95518164.993202455.1608084154-671070641.1608084154){target="_blank"}. When using eChecks, with the exception of an offsite gateway like PayPal, the response for eChecks will always be successful on Spreedly's end. Otherwise, the notification will happen outside of Spreedly. If a Transaction fails, the gateway user will be notified, and they will need to update the {{variable.Object_Transaction}} in Salesforce. #### What is the fee per transaction when using PayPal as a payment gateway? The fee per transaction when using PayPal as a payment gateway is 3.49% + a flat fee depending on the country. The flat fee for the USA is 0.49 USD (standard rate).
